about_the_game:
Step into the paws of brave, mischievous rats in Mischief, the full action-adventure experience from Tavern Rat Studios.

Explore a vibrant neighborhood from a rat’s-eye view as you scurry, scamper, and scheme your way through creative co-op challenges, zany minigames, and unforgettable boss battles. Designed for couch co-op chaos and heartfelt fun, Mischief reimagines classic multiplayer adventures for a new generation.

Chaotic Co-op Adventures

  • Team up with up to four local players and dive into an imaginative world brimming with charm and challenge.

  • Face off against larger-than-life household bosses like Shovul, Scourge of the Sandbox and Oscar, Pup of the Pit.

  • Use everyday objects like crayons, ketchup, and surge protectors in clever ways to overcome obstacles and prank your foes.

Competitive PvP Minigames

  • Break from teamwork and compete head-to-head in a variety of fast-paced minigames.

  • Test your reflexes in a zany shooting gallery where precision is key.

  • Race your friends on chaotic, obstacle-filled rat tracks.

  • Outmaneuver rivals in a platforming showdown where only one rat can reign supreme.

  • And more games to unlock and master!

A World of Whimsy and Wonder

  • Explore richly detailed environments built from everyday objects, viewed through the eyes of a rat.

  • Solve co-op puzzles that require communication and creativity.

  • Collect and celebrate your wins with over 100 unique achievements.

Mischief is a joyful blend of teamwork, rivalry, and chaos—a local multiplayer adventure that’s easy to pick up and impossible to put down.

short_description: Mischief is a delightful and imaginative action/adventure video game where you step into the paws of a courageous rat, navigating through a captivating world within the nooks and crannies of a typical home and a bustling backyard solo or with up to four local players!
